tasks.prompt: How many customers are there in total?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

tasks.prompt: List the names of customers in the UK region, alphabetically.
tasks.expected: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE region = 'UK' ORDER BY name

tasks.prompt: How many products are in the gear category?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'gear'

tasks.prompt: What is the average price, in dollars, of products in the outerwear category?
tasks.expected: SELECT AVG(price_cents) / 100.0 FROM products WHERE category = 'outerwear'

tasks.prompt: What is the name and price in dollars of the single most expensive product?
tasks.expected: SELECT name, price_cents / 100.0 FROM products ORDER BY price_cents DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.prompt: How many orders has the customer named Alice Ng placed in total?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Alice Ng'

tasks.prompt: How many orders have been cancelled?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE stat_cd = 'C'

tasks.prompt: How many orders have shipped?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE stat_cd = 'S'

tasks.prompt: List, alphabetically, the names of customers who have a returned order.
tasks.expected: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.stat_cd = 'R' ORDER BY c.name

tasks.prompt: List, alphabetically, the names of customers with an order that is still pending.
tasks.expected: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.stat_cd = 'P' ORDER BY c.name

tasks.prompt: Which customer has placed the most orders? Give their name.
tasks.expected: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.prompt: For every customer, how many orders have they placed? Give the customer name and the count.
tasks.expected: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

tasks.prompt: What is the total revenue, in dollars, across every order item?
tasks.expected: SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM order_items

tasks.prompt: What is the total revenue, in dollars, from orders placed by enterprise-tier customers?
tasks.expected: SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'enterprise'

tasks.prompt: List the names of products that have never appeared in an order.
tasks.expected: SELECT name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id)

tasks.prompt: Which single product has generated the most total revenue? Give its name.
tasks.expected: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_cents) DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.prompt: How many distinct products has the customer Ines Moreau ordered?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Ines Moreau'

tasks.prompt: For orders placed in June 2025, give the order id and its total value in dollars.
tasks.expected: SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.placed_at >= '2025-06-01' AND o.placed_at < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.id

tasks.prompt: How many customers are on the premium tier?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE tier = 'premium'

tasks.prompt: Which customers have never placed an order? List their names.
tasks.expected: SELECT name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

tasks.prompt: List the subjects of every high-priority support ticket, where priority 3 is high.
tasks.expected: SELECT subject FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 3

tasks.prompt: How many support tickets are still open, meaning they have no closed date?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL

tasks.prompt: On average, how many days does a closed support ticket stay open before it is closed?
tasks.expected: SELECT AVG(closed_at - opened_at) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL

tasks.prompt: For customers who have at least one support ticket, give their name and how many tickets they have.
tasks.expected: SELECT c.name, COUNT(t.id) FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

tasks.prompt: Which customers opened a support ticket about an order that was cancelled? List their names.
tasks.expected: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE o.stat_cd = 'C'

tasks.prompt: What is the most common order status code across every order?
tasks.expected: SELECT stat_cd FROM orders GROUP BY stat_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.prompt: How many orders are there of each status code? Give the status code and the count.
tasks.expected: SELECT stat_cd, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY stat_cd

tasks.prompt: What are the three most recently placed orders? Give the order id and the date it was placed.
tasks.expected: SELECT id, placed_at FROM orders ORDER BY placed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 3

tasks.prompt: What is the total number of items, counting quantity, ordered across every order?
tasks.expected: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM order_items

tasks.prompt: List the name and region of every customer whose region is not US, ordered by region.
tasks.expected: SELECT name, region FROM customers WHERE region <> 'US' ORDER BY region, name

tasks.prompt: What is the price, in dollars, of the cheapest product in the accessories category?
tasks.expected: SELECT MIN(price_cents) / 100.0 FROM products WHERE category = 'accessories'

tasks.prompt: How many orders contain more than one distinct product?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 1) sub

tasks.prompt: What is the total value, in dollars, of orders that were cancelled?
tasks.expected: SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.stat_cd = 'C'

tasks.prompt: List, alphabetically, the names of every enterprise-tier customer.
tasks.expected: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE tier = 'enterprise' ORDER BY name

tasks.prompt: How many products cost more than 100 dollars?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price_cents > 10000

tasks.prompt: What is the earliest order date on record?
tasks.expected: SELECT MIN(placed_at) FROM orders

tasks.prompt: List the ids of orders placed by customers in the SE region.
tasks.expected: SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'SE'

tasks.prompt: How many support tickets have no order linked to them?
tasks.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE order_id IS NULL

tasks.prompt: What is the total revenue, in dollars, from products in the gear category?
tasks.expected: SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_cents) / 100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'gear'

tasks.prompt: Which customers have placed more than one order? List their names, alphabetically.
tasks.expected: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY c.name
